It narrows the problem,' marks Policy internal structure, Policy conflict semantics, Numerical assessment, Statistical independence and Epistemic status Σ as 🔴 open in its own closure table, records its central hypothesis H₂₇₁ as HYPOTHESIS not theorem, and commissions a Step 272 ('Derive the minimum epistemic-status structure from distinguishability, contradiction, missingness, evidence assessment, supersession and inference') that does not exist anywhere in the corpus. Consequence stated as cutting both ways: post-258 agreement between the two trees is not independent corroboration and must be demoted to a single source, but a downstream source that has read a closure claim and still records 'does not declare closure' is disagreeing, not echoing — so Step 271's negative results are admissible as disagreement even though its positive results are not admissible as corroboration (G-13).

A proposed (not yet HPA-adopted) protocol defining the one lawful path by which a theory/independent-verification result may become book content, grounded in 'Research discovers · Verification tests · Governance decides · The book records.' Ten entry conditions must all hold before any book change is drafted (stable filesystem artifact identity with md5+counts; explicit per-claim evidence classes; findings separated from interpretations; unresolved items listed; contradictions preserved not harmonized; class-4/5 changes routed out of the book lane; no claim promoted merely by appearing in the report). A six-step procedure (Receive→Classify→Route→Await ruling→Draft→Verify) and permanent prohibitions follow (the book never rules on a theory question, never treats an AI-produced report as evidence, never edits a frozen/historical artifact to agree with a later finding), plus a production-freeze rule for reports arriving mid-Part-production.

A read-only book-lane readiness/synchronization audit (HPA mandate GN-72) finds zero book-text occurrences of 'theory is complete/closed/established' across 14 produced chapters, every treated open question presented as open with no OQ resolved, and no evidence class silently upgraded (I-11/I-12 never carried to TESTED). It proposes an explicit Part IV entry contract — what Part IV may claim, may consume (only governed artifacts, never a live investigation), what is outside scope (resolving any OQ, asserting implementation correspondence for formal objects), what must exist before Part IV begins, and what must remain explicitly NOT ESTABLISHED — requiring HPA adoption before Part IV production begins.
